blocks.intro: Every endpoint in this service, with the exact HTTP verbs it accepts. Where an endpoint accepts more than one verb they are all listed.
rows: LIVE 2026-07-26: THE 404s WERE A WRONG-HOST ERROR. DBMI is served on a dedicated <pod>-ing.<domain> host, NOT the pod/saas host. Proven with controls: <pod>-ing resolves (a public A record) while <pod>-bogusZZZ has no DNS, and the SAME path returns a bare 404 on the pod host but a real DBMI error envelope on -ing. GET -> 405 'Request method GET is not supported' = the POST verb EXISTS. POST with an empty body -> 500 'Cannot invoke Object.getClass() because o is null' = the handler PARSED and RAN our request (a null-deref on a missing body, not a routing miss). Body shape still unknown - run the validator loop against this host.

LIVE 2026-07-26: THE 404s WERE A WRONG-HOST ERROR. DBMI is served on a dedicated <pod>-ing.<domain> host, NOT the pod/saas host. Proven with controls: <pod>-ing resolves (a public A record) while <pod>-bogusZZZ has no DNS, and the SAME path returns a bare 404 on the pod host but a real DBMI error envelope on -ing. Returns {errorCode:404, errorMessage:'DBMI_TASK_WAS_NOT_FOUND'} for a bogus id - a DOMAIN 404 from a live handler, not an absent route. Discriminator on this host: 'No static resource <path>' = route ABSENT; any typed DBMI errorMessage = handler present.

LIVE 2026-07-26: THE 404s WERE A WRONG-HOST ERROR. DBMI is served on a dedicated <pod>-ing.<domain> host, NOT the pod/saas host. Proven with controls: <pod>-ing resolves (a public A record) while <pod>-bogusZZZ has no DNS, and the SAME path returns a bare 404 on the pod host but a real DBMI error envelope on -ing. Consistently 415 'Content-Type is not supported' on GET, with and without query params, and 405 on POST. 415 means the route is LIVE and content-negotiating - it is rejecting our media type, not the path. Unresolved: which Content-Type/Accept it wants (stripping our headers did not clear it). Real progress vs the previous bare 404.
